dict.string: Piwin uses the camera to scan a Host pairing QR code and to attach photos to a chat.
Piwin uses the microphone for hold-to-talk messages and Live voice calls.
Piwin converts your held speech into text on this device, then sends that text to your Host.
Piwin connects to your Piwin Host on your private network so you can use the app on this device.

Piwin reads only the Apple Health categories you allow (such as steps, activity, sleep, heart rate and weight) to create the health summaries you ask for. After you agree in the app, these summaries are sent to your own Piwin Host and then to the AI model provider you configured there. Health data is never used for advertising or sold.
Piwin never writes to or changes your Apple Health data. It only reads the categories you allow to create the health summaries you ask for.
